description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source testing management platform. It generates a webpage that lists test cases along with their execution custom field data, including features such as linking icons for execution, editing, and viewing execution history. The script handles retrieving test case data, custom fields, and platform information from database objects, and renders the results in a sortable HTML table with toolbar options.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class representing an extended table widget used to display test case and custom field data in a sortable, grouped HTML table.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and returns the argument object with settings for showing platforms, test plan and project IDs, names, and whether to display data.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up the GUI object with page titles, labels, test case prefix, and status code labels, based on provided database and argument objects.

methods.name: buildResultSet
methods.description: Builds the result set array containing test executions, linking custom fields and other metadata for display.

methods.name: getColumnsDefinition
methods.description: Returns an array of column definitions for the table display, adjustable for platform visibility and custom fields.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for accessing test plan metrics within the project.
